digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate and completion-verifier evidence contract
propositions: Attested evidence measurements taken under non-production privilege (wildcards, broader scopes) cannot fail for production reasons and carry zero information about actual authorization behavior
Current gates cannot audit measurement context because plan-review runs before evidence exists and completion-verifier accepts operator-attested claims by design, leaving escapes undetected
Four-field measurement-provenance contract (environment, principal, privilege_posture, instrument) must be forced into attested-evidence records as text to enable repo-grounded citation checks
Deterministic detector and advisory-tier LLM criterion must flag [operator-attested] claims lacking provenance declaration without re-running world measurements
Plans asserting unchanged behavior across substrate/route/provider changes while citing no configuration-consumer files on the resolution path mask defects by appearing disciplined
Evidence validity depends on whether the instrument used could have observed the specific failure mode it claims to rule out, not merely on confidence or rigor of the method
